reviews.t: recieved my order alot sooner than expected, was exactly ...
reviews.x: recieved my order alot sooner than expected, was exactly as decribed in description..only problem is i ordered them too short, they don't go thru my lip..it was my first time ordering for this piercing, i just got it done 3 months ago, so if it's your first time & you think it'll be okay because you're tired of the supet long ring, go a little longer, maybe a 6mm or 8mm & cut it down if needed, will be ordering a longer size from same seller!!
I love the post is a rubbery plastic I bite my post a lot and have chipped my tooth before.. I would of given 5 stars but shipping took longer then expected!

reviews.t: Awesome! Having angelbite piercings I lose labrets like no ...
reviews.x: Awesome! Having angelbite piercings I lose labrets like no other. I had to order two sets but it was well worth $8. These are more than I expected. The colours are vibrant and the labrets stay secure and intact. They arrived WAY sooner than the expected date, all and all very pleased with this product! :D
I love them but what they did to my lip after having it in for about 4 days is terrible I'm not sure if I'm allergic to them or what

Ok, I wanted to wait before I did a review on this product because I literally just got my labret done and it's not even healed. But the ball fell off of my starter jewelry and fell down the drain in my shower and these pieces were the only ones I had to replace it with unless I wanted to let it close up. I will admit it was hard to get on, the studs are very dainty and I kept dropping them while trying to align them with the post while I held it against my lip. I'm not sure how much of that tho

reviews.t: i like how easy they are too put on
reviews.x: I really like how easy they are too put on

reviews.t: These are great! And the stones do not fall out
reviews.x: These are great! And the stones do not fall out. They are easy to put in and the backs are disguised very well.

reviews.t: Fits perfect in my tragus piercing!
reviews.x: I use this jewelry in my tragus piercing. Fits perfect and they are so easy to put in. When I buy the ones with the balls that twist on they always fall out of my ear and get lost. I have not had a problem like that with this kind.

reviews.t: Thank you seller, no complaints here, happy customer!
reviews.x: I would first like to say that my order arrived much quicker than I expected which was amazing. My two orders of 10 earrings each were all intact. The quality is fairly good, some commenters mentioned that the backs of the earrings broke well I would say that may be true if you are handling these delicate PLASTIC studs rough. I had no problem getting these into my tragus piercings, I did however have to trim the length just a bit so they weren't too long in my ear but that was easy. It does take

reviews.t: posts go in easily, and the fit is nice and secure
reviews.x: Colors are vibrant, posts go in easily, and the fit is nice and secure, however, my shipment did arrive with one broken piece. The flat circular portion that would lay against the inside off my lip had broken clean off of the post. Hopefully this was a handling mishap at some point, and not an indication of the durability of the product.

reviews.t: These are perfect! I purchased many labrets online and just couldn't ...
reviews.x: These are perfect! I purchased many labrets online and just couldn't find the right fit. These are amazing. A couple did come in with the plastic bent. I wrote the company and they sent me replacements quickly. Very happy with these. The gem has not fallen out and usually mine always do. A+++

Great items. As expected better quality than expected for the price and I have ordered some thqat are nothing BUT TRASH. these ARE ABOVE AVERAGE QUALITY AND A wonderful PRICE FOR THE QUANTITY. HIGHLT recommend this seller.
Love these!! They lock together really well, I have mine in my monroe and never have worries or issues of it popping off, more snug than the twist steel ones... Love it!!
Love them! The only problem is on of the earings (clear part) is broken :( other than that very happy! They go on very smoothly and look great!

The gems were all intact when I received the package but they are SO TINY!  I'm actually afraid to put them in because if my lip gets bumped (and I have a rowdy toddler so it's very possible) and ANY swelling occurs this bad boy could easily be pulled through. I would not recommend this for a labret piercing and I would definitely make sure you only use these for a piercing that is well seasoned.  That being said, they are very pretty and I will try to make them work but they make me very nervou

Get them! These are awesome. Perfect length for my medusa/philtrum piercing. I bought basically the same thing at a hot topic like store and payed this much for one. This is a killer deal. The only complaint I have about bioplast as a whole, is the raw edges. I've had to clip the edges on the entry point of every bioplast I have. So if your piercing isn't totally healed, these will most likely hurt putting in. I received exactly what is pictured. No repeat/missing colors. I would buy these again

It took me a few tries to get use to placing them because Ive had my piercing for just 5 months, but they’re easy to place. The rhinestones haven’t fallen off and they didn’t give me an allergy reaction because by ears are sensitive. The price is awesome, but I had to order 2 because it’s 10 different colors, they don’t come in pairs. Comfortable to sleep in, they stick out a tad bit but it doesn’t bother me!

Been wearing mine for a couple months now and very pleased.  So long as you're not chewing on the backs of the piercings you shouldn't have to worry too much about durability.  These are probably the most comfortable lip studs I've worn in my 6 years of having my lips pierced.

Not god at all, i was happy to get it and it was the size i wanted and could cut it to fit my lip since i got the bar longer for that reason, when i cut it the platic split i guess and when i went to put it in in rippe my lip. Cheap and not worth the money or time...

Actually pretty nice..I normally don't like to buy from China bc of how hard it is to return ...but for this price I decided to take a chance..glad I did, it was worth the wait of about a week and they were the right size and a nice looking product for the price.

reviews.t: I wanted to try the bioplast because I thought it ...
reviews.x: I wanted to try the bioplast because I thought it might be easier on my gums, but it was the exact opposite.  Since the back is curved and not flat, it was constantly stabbing me in the gums.  Very uncomfortable and not able to wear.
Great deal for the price. I am changing the color of piercing almost every day, matching with my outfit. It fits perfectly and stays in doesn't come out easily, so no worries of loosing them:)

reviews.t: because my lip had a bad reaction to these
reviews.x: I didn't get around to trying more than one, because my lip had a bad reaction to these. Wish they would of worked out because they are super cute and you get so many colors.
I was expecting to have to be careful while wearing these and I was so wrong. I have not had any problem and they stay in perfectly and tight. The colors are adorable too.
Great little pieces of jewelry. I love that I can switch them out on the weekends to match my outfit. It fits perfectly inside with my clear piece I have to wear to work.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the jewelry is great quality and good value for the price.
Several reviewers report the pieces are easy to put in and stay secure.
Some reviewers mention shipping arrived faster than expected, though a few say it took longer.
A few reviewers received broken or bent pieces, though some had replacements sent quickly.
One reviewer had a bad reaction to the jewelry and another found the gems too tiny for a labret.
